title: notice-route shared definitions
description: Not an output on its own. Shared definitions referenced by the notification, CLI, hook and log schemas. config.json embeds its own copies.

level.description: Ordered info < warn < action < error. The order matters to destination floors and quiet hours; the notifiers do not use it.

destination_name.description: A destination name: 1 to 32 characters of [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*.

quiet_name.description: The name of a quiet_hours window (the destination name grammar).

rule_name.description: A rule name: 1 to 64 characters of [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*.

hook_name.description: The hook name of a hook payload: [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} (else payload_invalid with pointer /hook); untrusted where it comes from a payload.

label.description: A key=value label, split at the first =. Key [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}; value 0 to 256 characters of [A-Za-z0-9._:/#@+=,-].

duration.description: Seconds as a positive finite number, or a string matching [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(ms|s|m)? (no unit means seconds); zero is refused. Booleans are never accepted. Ranges are enforced by the loader and named in the key's description.

duration_long.description: As duration, plus the h and d suffixes; used only by the keys that name hours and days (retention.* and dedup_window). Ranges are enforced by the loader.

sha256_16.description: First 16 hex characters of a SHA-256.

sha256_64.description: A full SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex characters.

actor.description: human:<user> or auto:<name>. Advisory against same-user processes.

decision_id.description: A caller's --decision-id, recorded in the log only.

event_id.description: A producer's event id: an integer (a boolean is not one) or a string of 1 to 256 characters. The redelivery key compares its JSON text, so 17 and "17" differ.

destination_outcome.description: The outcome of one destination in a send. sent never means delivered or displayed.

history_outcome.description: A destination outcome as recorded in history: the eight of send plus sending (a row whose call is in progress or whose process died; never in send output) and expired (a queue row 24 hours old or more).

log_outcome.description: A destination outcome as logged: the eight of send plus expired.

history_reason.description: The closed reasons of history rows.

destination_reason.description: The closed reasons of send output and the log: the history reasons plus redelivered and repeat.

notifier_code.description: Untrusted. A notifier's error.code or refusal reason (read from its envelope and checked against this shape) or a router code: retries_exhausted, rate_capped, deployment_fault, exec_failed, output_overflow, killed, signal, expired, overflow.

noop_reason.description: Why no destination was called at the top level of send and test: unconfigured, no_rule, all_disabled, disabled (exit 22) or rule_drop (exit 0).

error_code.description: refused is exit 20; usage, config_invalid and config_unsafe are exit 2; internal is exit 1.

key.description: config_invalid and config_unsafe: a key path, home, --config, or the file path relative to the config directory (config_unsafe and unreadable files).

pointer.description: payload_invalid: empty for the whole input, /<field> (/? when the name does not match [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}), --source or --label. Never an input value.

error_details.description: Fixed strings and names only, never an input value; null when nothing applies.

message.description: A fixed string of the tool, never input text.

labels.description: All must be present among the notification's labels.

where.description: A map from payload field path to a string, integer or boolean; every pair must equal (same JSON type and value). Applies to hook payloads only; a condition that does not apply to a shape never matches it.

rule_match.description: All present conditions must hold. An empty match matches everything. source and labels apply to both shapes; hook, repo and where to hook payloads only; level_min to channel notices only (a notice without level counts as info) and may not be combined with hook or where.

wildcard.description: An exact value of 1 to 256 characters, or a value ending in one * (prefix match; a lone * matches any present value). A * is allowed only as the last character (** or an inner * is config_invalid); matching is case-sensitive.

tool.description: The source of a hook payload (1 to 64 characters of [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*, else payload_invalid with pointer /tool). The source notice-route is reserved: send refuses it with source_mismatch.

event_id.description: Read for the redelivery check, compared per destination, source and hook as its JSON text. Anything that is not an integer (a boolean is not) or a string of 1 to 256 characters is ignored.

repo.description: Matched by a rule's repo condition; null counts as absent.

items.description: A key=value string; a malformed one is ignored and counted in labels_ignored.

labels.description: Array of key=value strings (split at the first =). A value that is not an array is ignored and counted once in labels_ignored; at most 64 are read.

reads_third_party.description: Text opt-in needs the boolean false; any other value (missing, null, non-boolean) is unknown and excludes the text.

tainted.description: Text opt-in needs the boolean false; any other value is unknown and excludes the text.

hook_payload.description: A hook payload: required string tool and hook; any other keys are free, and the router reads only the scalar fields a rule or template names plus event_id, repo, labels, reads_third_party and tainted. Every field is untrusted unless the producer's interface says otherwise.

link.description: Lowercase http or https scheme, printable ASCII. Validated and never sent.

channel_notice.description: A channel notice: only title, message, level and link; message is required. A pass-through rule sends its title and message; its link is never sent.
